budget.rule: 10% of the worker's RAM (15.7 GB, the host's RAM)

estimate.rule: R12: 8 B per number / bool cell; per text cell (dates are text under engine_v1) 8 + share non-null × (50 + mean length) B; + 8 B index per row

plan.why: the estimated frame fits the budget: every row is read

frame.text: trained on all 603 training rows; holdout scored on all 147 rows

doctor.headline: Label noise (critical): Among the 30 most confident holdout predictions (max p̂ ≥ 0.811) the error is 0.300 [0.167, 0.479]; the model expects 0.123 there. cleanlab flags 23.8% of holdout labels. Even where the model is most sure it disagrees with the label this often, and it has learnt to expect it: an error floor, the signature of noisy labels (or of an outcome that is random given these features: reviewing the flagged labels tells the two apart).

secondary.reason: 'region' (67%), 'active' (33%, alone AUC 0.513) carry the most of the model's importance and nobody has said they are known when the decision is made. Open timing questions: a strong real signal and a column recorded after the outcome look the same here; only the timing settles it (a one-column run without each measures how much the score leans on it).
secondary.title: Decision-time questions

secondary.reason: WeightedEnsemble_L2 scores 0.7355 on validation but 0.6463 on the holdout: a gap of 0.0893, 2.4× the noise (holdout bootstrap SE 0.0371). accuracy on the training rows 0.8325 vs the holdout 0.6463: gap 0.1862, z = 5.0 (SE 0.0371).
secondary.title: Overfitting

secondary.reason: Holdout recall on '1' is 0.044 against a macro mean of 0.478 (n = 45); 43 of them were predicted '0'.
secondary.title: Weak class

eval_metric.scores_note: score_* are AutoGluon's higher-is-better scores; *_natural are in the metric's own units

oof.note: No bagging in this run (num_bag_folds = 0): no out-of-fold predictions.

notes: added SCORECARD (ensemble_models.scorecard) as the interpretable benchmark: binning (≤ 6 bins, ≥ 5% of rows each, monotone event rate) → weight of evidence → logistic regression → points (PDO 20, 600 at odds 50:1); bins are fitted on each fold's training rows only
